# Rao Farmaceutici

> > Rao Farmaceutici: Italian veterinary pharmacy specializing in pet supplements, antiparasitic products, and aquarium care solutions for dogs, cats, and aquatic animals.

Founded by Dr. Giorgio Rao, Rao Farmaceutici offers a comprehensive range of veterinary products including nervous system supplements (Dolorina Syrup with PEA), immune support formulations, antiparasitic collars (Seresto, Scalibor), and aquarium oxygenators. The site features educational content through FarmaBlog and serves both Italian and international markets.

## Veterinary Supplements & Medications

- [Dolorina Syrup for dogs and cats](https://raofarmaceutici.it/en/sistema-nervoso/3855-dolorina-syrup-90-g-buonapet-8032749651252.html): PEA-based nervous system supplement for pain management and neurological support in dogs and cats

- [Tetra Aquarium Oxygenators and Aerators](https://raofarmaceutici.it/it/ossigenatori-e-areatori/9107-.html): Professional-grade oxygenation and aeration equipment for aquarium water quality management
